subject: STABLE-CANDIDATE api-surface-sonnet #6: compute linked/stage-input wired (create_ex), tessellator + drawPatches encoder, encoder refusals (no unrecognized-selector crashes)
body: Host tests: api_surface_frontend_test (API_FAST, -O0) PASS incl. new groups api_test_compute_descriptor and api_test_tessellation; tessellator_test.py (ASan+UBSan, independent oracle, mutation-checked) PASS; iOS arm64 freestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror compile of compute_frontend.m clean. ASan full run + run_host_tests pending (lease). (1) LINKED/STAGE INPUT: new metal/tegu/compute_descriptor.inc (+runtime_pipeline.inc: method split teguNewComputePipelineWithFunction:descriptor:error:, weak tegu_air_pipeline_create_ex) marshals MTLComputePipelineDescriptor.linkedFunctions.{functions,privateFunctions,binaryFunctions} (each TeguFunction -> its OWN library handle + functionName + list), stageInputDescriptor (attributes/layouts/indexType/indexBufferIndex, has_stage_input=1 whenever the descriptor is non-nil) and maxCallStackDepth>1 into TeguAIRComputeCreateOptions v1; plain descriptors keep the byte-identical tegu_air_pipeline_create. Refused with a reason (pipeline nil+NSError, never dropped): linked groups, insertLibraries/preloadedLibraries, foreign/other-device/non-visible functions, out-of-range stage input. Real create_ex accepted depth=3, empty stage input and a self-linking list against the shared cdylib built 04:07. FUNCTION TABLES still waiting for shader-coverage: need uint32_t tegu_air_pipeline_function_handle(const TeguAIRPipeline*, const TeguAIRLibrary*, const uint8_t *name, size_t len, uint32_t *word) (0 ok; nonzero for private/unlinked/kernel; dedup per handles() in pipeline/table.rs). (2) TESSELLATION: metal/tegu/tessellator.h (triangle+quad, pow2/integer/fractional_odd/fractional_even, half factor structs, culling, winding) + tests/tessellator_test.py; api_tess.inc: setTessellationFactorBuffer/Scale, drawPatches (direct + CPU-indirect with execution-time verify), per-patch/instance factor addressing (step functions, instanceStride), stream = struct{u32 patch,instance; f32 position_in_patch[3]} bound at slot info->streamSlot (proposed 30) + 32-bit index buffer drawn as ONE indexed triangle list; slot binding restored. NOT working end to end: air_bridge.rs refuses g.tessellation so tegu_pipeline_tess_info() returns NULL and every drawPatches fails the command (logged TEGU_FRONTEND UNSUPPORTED tessellation_pipeline); the test injects a TeguTessInfo to prove the glue. Needed from shader-coverage when it builds the tessellation pipeline: export (domain, controlPoints) of the post-tessellation function and consume the stream at slot 30 as [[patch_id]], [[instance_id]], [[position_in_patch]]. drawIndexedPatches (control point index buffer) refused until a control-point fetch ABI exists. HEURISTICS to verify on device: triangle edge order (u=0,v=0,w=0), quad edge order (u=0,v=0,u=1,v=1), fractional born-at-centre placement, culling of inside<=0, clockwise orientation convention. (3) ENCODER REFUSALS: generated metal/tegu/api_encoder_refusals.inc (render 50, compute 7, blit 7 SDK selectors: function/intersection tables, accel structures, vertex amplification, mesh/object, tile, ICB execute, counters) -> command buffer fails with a logged reason instead of an unrecognized-selector exception. Hashes: tessellator.h 2cfe7404, api_tess.inc 7c9a4a07, compute_descriptor.inc b9b93d9b, api_encoder_refusals.inc b0f751de, runtime_pipeline.inc 924226bf, render_encoder.inc dcf42ce1, api_surface.inc db22fa66, api_surface_host_test.inc 7066ee3f, tests/tessellator_test.py e0adff29.
